one_liner.value: Slack offers an OAuth2‑based API with bearer tokens for building AI agents.

gating_notes.value: Requires creating a Slack app and completing OAuth flow; no paid plan needed.
gating_notes.quote: OAuth allows a user in any Slack workspace to install your app.

oauth_details.value: OAuth flow uses a redirect to https://slack.com/oauth/v2/authorize with client_id and scopes, then exchanges a code for an access token.
oauth_details.quote: Redirecting a user to Slack can be done with a single link. For example: https://slack.com/oauth/v2/authorize?scope=incoming-webhook&client_id=...

docs_url.quote: The Slack Web API is an interface for querying information from and enacting change in a Slack workspace.

auth_methods.quote: At the end of the OAuth flow, your app gains an access token.

primary_auth.quote: Slack apps are installed with a v2 OAuth 2.0 flow.

credential_access.quote: Nope! It’s completely free to join.

api_type.quote: The Web API is a collection of HTTP RPC-style methods.

api_breadth.quote: We've got quite a bit of API methods!
